nlmixr2save events

Source: vignettes/events.Rmd
events.Rmd

nlmixr2save tells loggers what was assigned: when fit := nlmixr2(...) finishes, a logger learns that the result was named fit, whether it came from the cache, and the hash it was stored under. It does this by reporting to the rxode2 event bus.

The event bus in one paragraph

rxode2 provides a small publish/subscribe mechanism: packages call rxode2::rxEventEmit(event, ...) when a top-level operation finishes, and any function registered with rxode2::rxEventListen(id, fun) is called as fun(event, ...) with the payload fields as named arguments. Events are only delivered from the outermost operation (scope depth 0), so the fits inside a bootstrap or the solves inside a fit are silent. See ?rxode2::rxEventListen for the full API (rxEventScope(), rxEventDepth(), rxEventSeq(), …).

Other packages emit the events that describe the work (fitComplete from nlmixr2est::nlmixr2(), solveComplete from rxode2::rxSolve(), …). nlmixr2save emits the events that describe the assignment around that work. Every emitter checks that the bus exists first, so with an older rxode2 nothing is emitted and nothing breaks.

Events emitted by nlmixr2save

Function Events
x := value assignStart, then assign or assignAbort
saveFit(fit) assign (only outside :=, only for a fit)

assignStart

Emitted by := before anything is evaluated or loaded, so a logger can attribute every event that follows (a fitComplete, a solveComplete) to the name being assigned.

Field Meaning
name The name on the left of := (NULL if it is not a symbol)

assign

Emitted by := when it returns successfully, whether the value was computed or restored from the cache.

Field Meaning
name The name assigned (same as in assignStart)
value The value assigned (a fit, a simulation, a data frame, …)
call The right-hand side of :=, normalized by rxode2 so it never embeds large values
envir The environment the name was assigned in
cached TRUE when the value was restored from disk instead of computed
sha The hash the value is cached under (NULL in trusted-cache mode, options(nlmixr2save.check = FALSE))
random TRUE when the right-hand side is a random/simulation function (rxSolve(), vpcSim(), …)
seed For a random result, the random seed captured before it ran; NULL otherwise
since rxode2::rxEventSeq() just after assignStart; events delivered after it belong to this assignment

since lets a logger collect the events produced by the right-hand side: every event whose sequence number is greater than since and that was delivered before this assign belongs to it.

assignAbort

Emitted by := when the right-hand side (or the saving) errors. The only field is name. A logger can drop whatever it collected since the matching assignStart.

assign from saveFit()

A direct saveFit() of an nlmixr2 fit reports an assign after the fit is written, with the same fields:

  • name is the file argument when given, otherwise the name of the variable passed as fit (saveFit(fit) reports "fit");
  • cached = FALSE, random = FALSE, and sha, seed and since are NULL;
  • there is no assignStart and no assignAbort: a saveFit() that errors emits nothing.

saveFit() vs :=. When := saves a fit it calls saveFit() internally; that inner saveFit() is silent and only the := reports. So every saved fit is reported exactly once: by := when it was assigned with :=, otherwise by saveFit(). saveFit() of anything that is not a fit (for example a plain list) emits nothing.

What is not emitted

  • Hash evaluations. To build its cache key, := evaluates the arguments of the right-hand side (or, for nlmixr2(), the estimation properties). That evaluation runs inside an event scope, so in a := augPred(nlmixr2(model, data, est = "posthoc")) the fit computed only to hash the call is silent; only the fit that produces the value reports a fitComplete.
  • Cache hits produce no work events. When the value is restored from disk, the right-hand side is not run, so the sequence is just assignStart and assign with cached = TRUE.
  • Anything inside another operation’s scope. A := that runs inside a fit, a solve or any other scoped operation emits nothing, like every other event.

Nested :=

A := evaluated while another := is running its right-hand side (for example inside a function called on the right) reports normally, and its assign arrives before the outer one:

assignStart(outer) -> assignStart(inner) -> assign(inner) -> assign(outer)

The outer := saves and restores its own state around the inner one, so the outer assign still carries its own sha, and an inner saveFit() inside either one stays silent.

Listening

A listener is any function(event, ...). This one just records what it is told:

library(nlmixr2save)
library(nlmixr2est)

events <- new.env()
events$log <- list()
rxode2::rxEventListen("demo", function(event, ...) {
  p <- list(...)
  events$log[[length(events$log) + 1L]] <- list(event = event, payload = p)
})
seen <- function() {
  vapply(events$log, function(e) {
    if (is.null(e$payload$name)) e$event else paste0(e$event, "(", e$payload$name, ")")
  }, character(1))
}

A small model to fit:

one <- function() {
  ini({
    tka <- log(1.57); tcl <- log(2.72); tv <- log(31.5)
    eta.ka ~ 0.6; eta.cl ~ 0.3; eta.v ~ 0.1
    add.sd <- 0.7
  })
  model({
    ka <- exp(tka + eta.ka)
    cl <- exp(tcl + eta.cl)
    v <- exp(tv + eta.v)
    linCmt() ~ add(add.sd)
  })
}

The first := runs the fit. When the installed nlmixr2est has the event hooks, its fitComplete arrives between the two nlmixr2save events (assignStart(fit), fitComplete, assign(fit)); with an nlmixr2est without them only the two nlmixr2save events are seen:

fit := nlmixr2(one, nlmixr2data::theo_sd, est = "posthoc",
               control = list(print = 0))
seen()
#> [1] "assignStart(fit)" "fitComplete"      "assign(fit)"
a <- events$log[[length(events$log)]]$payload
a$cached
#> [1] FALSE
a$sha
#> [1] "7627ce8c37bb6ce794f615d561390c0dc1bbc31d"
as.call(as.list(a$call)) # the right-hand side of `:=`
#> nlmixr2(one, nlmixr2data::theo_sd, est = "posthoc", control = list(print = 0))

Running it again restores the fit from fit.zip; nothing is fit, so only the assignment is reported:

events$log <- list()
fit := nlmixr2(one, nlmixr2data::theo_sd, est = "posthoc",
               control = list(print = 0))
seen()
#> [1] "assignStart(fit)" "assign(fit)"
events$log[[2]]$payload$cached
#> [1] TRUE

A simulation is flagged as random and carries the seed it started from:

events$log <- list()
ev <- rxode2::et(amt = 320) |> rxode2::et(0:24)
set.seed(42)
sim := rxode2::rxSolve(fit, ev, nSub = 2)
seen()
#> [1] "assignStart(sim)" "solveComplete"    "assign(sim)"
a <- events$log[[length(events$log)]]$payload
a$random
#> [1] TRUE
!is.null(a$seed)
#> [1] TRUE
a$since
#> [1] 6

An error on the right-hand side reports assignAbort:

events$log <- list()
try(bad := nlmixr2(one, nlmixr2data::theo_sd, est = "notAnEst"), silent = TRUE)
seen()
#> [1] "assignStart(bad)" "assignAbort(bad)"

A direct saveFit() reports one assign named after the file:

events$log <- list()
saveFit(fit, "fitCopy")
seen()
#> [1] "assign(fitCopy)"

And a nested :=:

events$log <- list()
inner <- function() {
  y := data.frame(b = 2)
  data.frame(c = 3)
}
outer := inner()
seen()
#> [1] "assignStart(outer)" "assignStart(y)"     "assign(y)"         
#> [4] "assign(outer)"

Remove the listener when done:

rxode2::rxEventUnlisten("demo")

Stable fit keys

:= caches a result built on a fit (sim := rxSolve(fit, ev), a := augPred(fit)) under a hash of its arguments. Serializing a fit to hash it is not stable: a fit reloaded from its zip in a new session differs byte-wise from the fresh one (loader fields, delayed bindings, tables that went through a csv file). So := hashes a fit on its right-hand side with nlmixr2saveFitKey() instead, and that result is a cache hit in a new session too. Both keys are lists meant to be hashed, and neither forces nor writes anything in the fit.

  • nlmixr2saveFitIdentity(fit) says which fit it is: the model (normalized model, error lines and initial estimates table), the estimation method, the fixed effects, the omega matrix and the data. It is the same for a fit, its saveFit()/loadFit() reload, and the fit after addCwres().
  • nlmixr2saveFitKey(fit) adds everything a downstream result could depend on: the column names, the objective function rows and values, the covariance and its method, the table values, and (with sha = TRUE, the default) the hash := stored on the fit.

Numbers are rounded to 10 to 12 significant digits so a csv round trip does not change the keys. What invalidates a := cache built on a fit is anything that changes nlmixr2saveFitKey():

Change to the fit Identity Key (invalidates :=)
saveFit() then loadFit(), a new R session same same
addCwres(), addNpde(), addTable() (new columns) same changes
setOfv() (new objective function row) same changes
a new covariance (preconditionFit(), …) same changes
different estimates, data, model or method changes changes 
fit2 <- loadFit("fitCopy")
identical(digest::digest(nlmixr2saveFitIdentity(fit)),
          digest::digest(nlmixr2saveFitIdentity(fit2)))
#> [1] TRUE
identical(digest::digest(nlmixr2saveFitKey(fit, sha = FALSE)),
          digest::digest(nlmixr2saveFitKey(fit2, sha = FALSE)))
#> [1] TRUE

Loggers can use nlmixr2saveFitIdentity() to recognize the same fit across fitComplete, fitUpdate and assign events, even after it was saved and reloaded.

Full logging

To record all of these events (with the fits, simulations and results they describe) to a log, use the nlmixr2log package, which listens to the bus and turns assignStart/assign into named entries.
